name: Stanford Medicine Children's Health Teen Volunteer Program
org: Stanford Medicine Children's Health (Lucile Packard Children's Hospital)
what_you_do: Right now teens can only volunteer in the hospital Gift Shop. The program also lists five areas: mother and baby care, play and recreation, support services, education, and community-based activities.
who_can_apply: Teens age 16 or 17. You need the same weekly shift for at least 6 months. Only Gift Shop roles are open to teens now.
duration: At least 6 months, same day and time each week
deadline_text: Orientation sign-up is closed as of Nov 2, 2026, and no sessions are scheduled. There is no waitlist. Check the portal for new dates.
how_to_apply: Sign up for the online orientation for minors when it reopens, then do a group interview. Eligible teens get the application link after that. Questions: volunteerservices@stanfordchildrens.org.
notes: Do not sign up unless you want the Gift Shop. Adults 18 and older use a separate link.
